changePrimaryDescription: This will make {{name}} your primary agent, do you want to do this?
preparingHelp: Required resources are being prepared. Work stays queued.
verifyingHelp: The saved execution configuration is being checked. Work stays queued.
pausingHelp: Waiting for execution and required resources to stop.
resumingHelp: Required resources are being started. Work stays queued.
cleaningUpHelp: Required resources are being removed. Termination is not complete.
lifecycleRefreshError: Could not refresh agent lifecycle status.
name: Name
title: Title
promptPlaceholder: You are agent {{agentName}}. Your role is {{role}}...
promptWarning: Prompt template is replayed on every heartbeat. Keep it compact and dynamic to avoid recurring token cost and cache churn.
forcedEnvironmentHelp: This instance runs all agents in the Kubernetes sandbox. Local execution is disabled.
missingKubernetes: This instance requires the Kubernetes sandbox, but no managed Kubernetes environment is available for this organization yet. Configure one before creating agents; execution will not fall back to local.
bootstrapPlaceholder: Optional initial setup prompt for the first run
bootstrapWarning: Bootstrap prompt is legacy and will be removed in a future release. Consider moving this content into the agent's prompt template or instructions file instead.
captureTracesHelp: Stores exact provider traffic for every future run until disabled. Traces may contain sensitive prompts and tool arguments, are administrator-only, and expire after 24 hours.
tracesEnabled: Raw tracing is on for future runs. Paperclip keeps at most 64 MiB per run and automatically deletes it after 24 hours.
helpTitle: Job title shown in the org chart.
helpReportsTo: The agent this one reports to in the org hierarchy.
helpPromptTemplate: Sent on every heartbeat. Keep this small and dynamic. Use it for current-task framing, not large static instructions. Supports {{agentId}}, {{agentName}}, {{agentRole}} and other template variables.
helpAdapterType: How this agent runs: local CLI (Claude/Codex/OpenCode), OpenClaw Gateway, spawned process, or generic HTTP webhook.
helpCwd: Deprecated legacy working directory fallback for local adapters. Existing agents may still carry this value, but new configurations should use project workspaces instead.
helpBootstrapPrompt: Only sent when Paperclip starts a fresh session. Use this for stable setup guidance that should not be repeated on every heartbeat.
helpLocalCommand: Override the path to the CLI command you want the adapter to call (e.g. /usr/local/bin/claude, codex, opencode).
helpExtraArgs: Extra CLI arguments for local adapters, comma-separated.
helpHeartbeatInterval: Run this agent automatically on a timer. Useful for periodic tasks like checking for new work.
helpTimeoutSec: Maximum seconds a run can take before being terminated. 0 means no timeout.
helpGraceSec: Seconds to wait after sending interrupt before force-killing the process.
helpWakeOnDemand: Allow this agent to be woken by assignments, API calls, UI actions, or automated systems.
helpCooldownSec: Minimum seconds between consecutive heartbeat runs.
helpMaxConcurrentRuns: Maximum number of heartbeat runs that can execute simultaneously for this agent.
helpMaxTurnContinuationEnabled: Automatically queue bounded continuation runs when an adapter stops because its per-run turn cap was exhausted.
helpMaxTurnContinuationMaxAttempts: Maximum automatic continuations after one max-turn stop. This is separate from max turns per run.
helpMaxTurnContinuationDelaySec: Seconds to wait before starting each max-turn continuation.
helpSecretAccess: Secrets this agent can reach. Env-var bindings are injected at run start; API-access bindings are fetched on demand via the run-bound agent API and never written to the environment.
testOrganization: Select an organization to test adapter environment
testSettingsFailed: Could not load environment settings to determine which environment to test in. Retry the test.
noModelDetected: No model detected. Select or enter one manually.
openCodeDiscovery: Live OpenCode model discovery only runs for Local environments. Using the curated list and manual entry for {{environment}}.
minimalSearchWarning: Codex may reject `minimal` thinking when search is enabled.
helpThinkingEffort: Control model reasoning depth. Supported values vary by adapter/model.
managedSandboxUnavailable: This instance runs agents only in its managed sandbox environment, but no managed sandbox environment is available to test in. Check that the managed sandbox provider is active, then retry the test.
